title: Prisma drift check before deploy
l0: Run Prisma migrate status before deploy.
l1: Use bun prisma migrate status against staging to confirm there is no schema drift before opening the release gate.

title: Prisma rollback rehearsal after drift
l0: Rehearse rollback when Prisma drift appears.
l1: If bun prisma migrate status reports drift, rehearse the rollback plan in staging before retrying the release gate.

title: Prisma seed verification
l1: Run bun prisma db seed after migration status is clean.

title: Seed script tenant fixtures
l0: Tenant fixtures require seeded billing accounts.
l1: The seed script must create billing account fixtures before tenant hydration tests run.

title: Keep generated Prisma client untouched
l0: Patch repository adapters instead of generated Prisma client files.
l1: Do not edit generated Prisma client output; update repository adapter mappings and regenerate cleanly.

title: Prisma migration lock timeout
l0: Migration status can fail on an advisory lock timeout.
l1: When Prisma reports advisory lock timeout during migration status, wait for the deploy job to release the lock before retrying.
